observations: Photo 0: A black Dell laptop is open, held by a hand. The keyboard and trackpad are visible. The Dell logo is on the bezel below the screen. A stack of identical laptops is visible beneath it. A blue Intel sticker is on the lower right of the palm rest.

Photo 1: The closed lid of a black Dell laptop is shown, with the Dell logo centered. The laptop is placed on top of a stack of identical laptops. The side ports are visible: USB-A, HDMI, and a round power port. A blue Intel sticker is on the lower left corner of the lid.
Photo 2: The same laptop is open and placed on top of the stack. The screen is off. The Dell logo is visible on the bezel. The Intel sticker is on the palm rest. An Apple iMac is in the background.
All photos show a stack of identical laptops, suggesting bulk or resale. The laptops appear to be in used condition with some wear on the keyboard and screen bezel.

The screen size is not labeled. The bezel is typical of a 14-inch laptop, but the resolution cannot be confirmed from the photos. The screen is off, so no display output is visible.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the model label on the bottom of the laptop.
A screenshot of the system information showing CPU, RAM, and storage details.
A photo of the screen turned on, displaying a solid color or test pattern.
A close-up photo of the bottom casing, hinges, and ports.
response.reason: The model and specifications cannot be confirmed from the photos alone. The seller's claims are unverified or unverifiable remotely. The item must be priced at its worst case until proof is provided, which requires additional photos or screenshots.
